title: Raw CSP value as a filtered expectation
statement: Let $V$ be a set on which equality is decidable, and let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template. For natural numbers $r,M$ with $r\le M$, suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. For any assignment of values in $D$ to $V\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$, its value on the raw CSP instance formed from globally filtered clone occurrences, viewed as a real number, equals the expected padded-clone payoff when the occurrence is sampled uniformly from the globally filtered occurrences.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
